rubric.description: Uses a loop that traverses every element of list
Correctly accumulates the running sum (Integer values auto-unbox correctly for the addition)
Uses a loop that starts at list.size() - 1
The loop correctly decrements down to and including index 0
Correctly checks whether the element at each index is negative
Correctly removes the element when it is negative
Uses a loop that traverses every index of list
Correctly computes double the value at each index
Uses set() to replace the element at that index with the doubled value (not add())
